name: HypeBridge
oneliner: Find and check creators for your brand by describing who you want.
summary: {name} is a web app that helps brands find and evaluate social media creators. Describe the creator you want in plain language, then get an AI-assisted read on a creator's engagement, audience, content, and fit with your brand.
description: {name} helps brands decide which creators to work with. Instead of filtering a database by follower counts, you describe the creator you want in plain language, such as the niche, the audience, and the size, and {name} returns matches with the reasons each one fits.

For any creator handle, {name} builds an evaluation: a score, engagement and audience numbers, a content snapshot, strengths, and areas to watch. A brand-fit check compares each creator against your own checklist.
{name} is live on the web at thehypebridge.com.

features.title: Discover
features.body: Describe your ideal creator in plain language and get ranked matches with the reasons they fit.

features.title: Evaluate
features.body: Look up a creator to see engagement quality, audience, content patterns, and growth.

features.title: Brand fit
features.body: Check each creator against your own checklist before you reach out.

faq.a: {name} is a creator discovery and evaluation tool for brands, made by Modrn Magic. It runs on the web at thehypebridge.com.
